title: BULK APEX vs Creatine RAW
directVerdict: BULK APEX is the better fit for strength and power, while Creatine RAW is the better fit for strength and power.
majorFormulaDifferences: Only BULK APEX discloses: Beta-Alanine: 5 g per full serving; Calcium HMB: 3 g per full serving; Betaine Anhydrous: 2.5 g per full serving; Taurine: 2 g per full serving; L-Tyrosine: 1 g per full serving; Caffeine Anhydrous: 300 mg per full serving; Pink Himalayan Salt: 300 mg per full serving; Bitter Orange Extract: 160 mg per full serving.
BULK APEX caffeine: BULK APEX officially lists 400 mg total caffeine per 1 scoop (25.5 g). Creatine RAW caffeine: Creatine RAW is stimulant-free and lists no caffeine.
experience: BULK APEX: BULK APEX: The premium BULK strength formula with disclosed creatine, HMB, betaine, and elevATP. The easiest concrete points are 5 g Creatine Monohydrate, 3 g Calcium HMB, 400 mg official total caffeine. Creatine RAW: Creatine RAW: A single-ingredient micronized Creatine Monohydrate powder. The easiest concrete points are 5 g Creatine Monohydrate, 60 servings, Single ingredient.
chooseFirstWhen: Customers seeking 5 g creatine and 3 g HMB
tradeoffs: BULK APEX: Stimulant-sensitive shoppers; A lower-MAP strength SKU
Creatine RAW: Customers who want a complete flavored pre-workout
bottomLine: Match the recommendation to the buyer’s primary goal: BULK APEX for strength and power; Creatine RAW for strength and power.
